UCL IIPP Working Paper Series · November 2024

Leveraging Digital Public Infrastructures for the Common Good in Brazil

with Mariana Mazzucato, Giulia Pagliarini

Explores how Brazil can design and govern digital public infrastructure according to 'common good' principles to support inclusive and sustainable economic transformation, using Brazil's Rural Environmental Registry (CAR) as a case study. Builds on a partnership between UCL IIPP and Brazil's Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services.
